Title: Azure App Service—Increased scale out limits for Premium v2 plans

Body.Content:
Azure App Service has increased the maximum scale out limit for App Service Premium v2 plans to 30 instances in the select regions listed here. The Azure portal scale out UX, Azure auto-scale rules, and command line tools can all be used to increase the instance count of an App Service Premium v2 plan up to 30 instances.

The increased scale out limit is currently available in these regions:

Canada Central

Japan East

Central US
East US
North Central US
South Central US
West US 2

West India
South India

Australia Southeast
Australia East
Australia Central

UK West
UK South

North Europe
West Europe

East Asia
Southeast Asia

Korea South
Korea Central

Learn more about Azure App Service pricing plans.
